visualCharacteristics: 3 equal square rounded images in a row at desktop (410px each at 1440), optional small uppercase centered caption below.
contentPattern: one card per image (image cell, optional caption text cell), 3 square images in a row
usage: Image-only gallery strip of square photos, e.g. the three Amalfi scenes on destination pages.
reuseGuidance: Add one card per photo: an image (with alt text) and an optional short caption. Images are cropped square. Use three cards for a full row at desktop. For cards with headings, body copy or links use the base cards block.
